start.Description: Scene start. Stage-2 network-coverage window (from speaker-bearing rows), not necessarily the full 01a scene span. Mapping to fMRI run time / TRs is the consumer's responsibility.

end.Description: Scene end. Stage-2 network-coverage window (from speaker-bearing rows), not necessarily the full 01a scene span. Mapping to fMRI run time / TRs is the consumer's responsibility.

n_nodes.Description: Characters present in the scene interaction graph.

n_edges.Description: All edges (character pairs) in the scene graph, including pure co-presence edges (contrast n_interaction_edges).

density.Description: networkx graph density of the scene graph (0-1).

n_components.Description: Connected components in the scene graph.

n_interaction_edges.Description: Edges with nonzero adjacency or proximity (true interaction, not pure co-presence).

interaction_entropy.Description: Shannon entropy (bits) of the scene's edge-weight distribution; higher = speech/interaction more evenly spread.
